component.name: Todofy
component.summary: Plan your day with smart lists, reminders and focus timers

description.p: Todofy is a local-first to-do app. Everything lives in a database on your own machine and stays usable offline; signing in to sync an account across devices is optional.

ul.li: Smart lists for Today, Upcoming and anything overdue, alongside your own projects and labels
Natural-language quick add, so "pay rent every 1st at 9am" becomes a dated, recurring task
A global capture window on a keyboard shortcut, from wherever you are
Recurring tasks, subtask checklists, a Kanban board and a month calendar
Pomodoro and per-task stopwatch timers that keep counting across restarts
Desktop reminders, a daily journal, and optional on-device voice input

screenshot.caption: Today, with due dates, priorities and labels
A Kanban board for a project
A focus timer running against a task

description.p: Optional on-device voice input for tasks and journal entries, managed from Settings.
